question: Which architectural zones are delimited by the terms kalānta and prastarāntaka?
premises: The extent reaches up to kalā
Levels beginning with yuga are included
The neck and the end of the entablature are specified
inference: The described arrangement spans from levels such as yuga through the neck up to the end of the entablature and kalā
uncertainties: The precise technical boundaries of kalānta and yugabhūmyādi are context-dependent
